comparison.objective: Pay cable from a free-turning drum into a cradle, versus commissioning an axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Cable routing and drum restraint, not tool-mediated unlocking, fine collar tuning, or impact-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Cable routed, connector cradled, and drum safely stopped; numeric drum/runaway thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Tests flexible-line management and residual drum motion, not damper adjustment and validated dynamic stopping.
